crossRefs.note: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts…
But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is…
As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised; just so they may not be…
From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling…
crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and…
“He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’”
They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for…
There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.
They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing…
Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?
Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more…
He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall.…
Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone;
even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him…
For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
but we preach Christ crucified: a stumbling block to Jews, and foolishness to Greeks,
and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they…
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…

translations.web: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
translations.bsb: Now, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.
translations.kjv: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
translations.asv: But I, brethren, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? then hath the stumbling-block of the cross been done away.
